name: zeitvex
did: 建站与全部工程实现：数据闸门与校验、按品类生成页面、部件库检索与对比、参数口径页、供应商页、贡献者页；达妙 / 灵足 / 大疆 / 宇树四家的 A 级参数逐条核对（扭矩统一到输出端、缺字段一律写 null）；把「来源可追溯」做成机器可查的规则，而不是写在文档里的一句话。
did_en: Builds and maintains the whole engineering side: the data gate and validation, per-category page generation, the parts explorer and comparison, the semantics page, suppliers and contributors; verified every A-tier spec for DAMIAO, RobStride, DJI and Unitree (torque normalised to the output side, missing values written as null) and turned traceability into machine-checked rules.

name: Dichen33
did: 整机数据 15 台（含 URDF / 仓库链接）、上位机与下位机批量扩充、IMU 与相机雷达补充—— 共 50 条数据进入目录；另写了一份《部件资料收集指南》，把「从开源项目找到型号 → 进官网 → 落地」的流程固定成规范。另外「遥控器」这一整个品类是他从 ccc 分支带进来的：5 个遥控器 + 2 个 CAN 模块（含 7 张实拍图、参数与备注），顺手把部件页备注改成分组卡片；并加了「首页品类卡点击后预选对应品类」—— 跳转带 ?cat=，从首页点「电源」直接落到该品类。
did_en: 15 whole-robot entries with URDF/repo links, a bulk expansion of high- and low-level controllers plus IMU/camera/LiDAR — 50 data rows in total — and the part-data collection guide. The remote-controller category came from his ccc branch: 5 transmitters and 2 CAN modules with 7 product photos, specs and notes, plus the grouped-card layout for part notes and the home-page category jump that preselects the category.

name: JadeCrane
did: 芯片品类从 14 颗补到 18 颗：新增 STM32H723 / TCAN334G / TMC2209 / AS5600；为 18 颗补齐官方文档页、手册 PDF 与官方仓库链接（逐条实测可打开）；补 17 颗的国内 1+ 挂牌价（含来源与采集日期）；补 12 张商品实拍图。另外登记了 doc_url / doc_pdf / repo_urls 三个参数名，让校验器的 20 条误报消失（82 → 62 警告）。
did_en: Expanded the chip category from 14 to 18 parts (STM32H723 / TCAN334G / TMC2209 / AS5600), added official doc pages, datasheet PDFs and official repos for all 18 (each link verified), domestic 1+ prices for 17 of them with source and collection date, and 12 product photos. Also registered the doc_url / doc_pdf / repo_urls keys, clearing 20 false warnings (82 → 62).
